page_title: GRA 3-2 MAL | Granada CF v Mallorca 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' 11:27 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.

90+8' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francisco Maeso with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javier Llabres (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+7' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) strikes the ball from a long-range free kick. His shot only flies miles away of the right post. What a poor kick! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
90+6' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90+4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Perea (Granada CF) comes onto the pitch for Myrto Uzuni.
90+3' Granada CF are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. It will be a corner kick for Granada CF.
90+2' Javier Aguirre (Mallorca) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.

90+2' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Raul Fernandez to get hold of the ball.
90+1' 9 additional min. will be played.
90+1' Samuel Costa (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Francisco Maeso signals a set piece.
90' Alberto Soro (Granada CF) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' 3 - 2 Goal! Samuel Costa (Mallorca) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
87' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
86' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.

86' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.

85' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Mallorca win a corner.

83' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
83' Paco Lopez decides to make a substitution. Jose Callejon will be replaced by Alberto Soro (Granada CF).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Famara Diedhiou (Granada CF) will replace Oscar Melendo.
81' Fouls committed – 10:22.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

79' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Toni Lato will be replaced by Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
75' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
74' The resulting set piece from Granada CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Decent spell from Granada CF here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Granada CF.
73' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.
72' Here is a change. Omar Mascarell is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
72' Substitution. Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) replaces Bryan Zaragoza.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Victor Diaz (Granada CF) replaces Sergio Ruiz.
70' 3 - 1 Goal! Predrag Rajkovic gets a hand on the penalty from Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
70' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
68' The players claim that Cyle Larin (Mallorca) handled the ball and it seems they are right. No point in arguing there. Granada CF will take a penalty kick.
68' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
68' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
68' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Granada CF will have an opportunity.
67' Granada CF quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
67' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Granada CF will take a corner.
66' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
64' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Granada CF for a penalty. Play continues.
63' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
62' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
61' 1:0 – the corner kicks stats.

58' The free kick from long distance is taken by Jose Callejon (Granada CF), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
57' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Abdon Prats walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
57' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Costa (Mallorca) replacing Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud.
55' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker over the crossbar.
55' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:14.
54' Toni Lato (Mallorca) trips an opposition player and Francisco Maeso signals a foul.
51' Relief for Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) as the ref reverses his original red card decision and shows a yellow instead.

50' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca), but referee Francisco Maeso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
50' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
48' Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.

46' 2 - 1 GOAL 2:1! Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.

45+4' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball misses the right post by a few inches. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
45+2' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
45+2' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
45+2' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
45' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
44' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle after Jose Callejon (Granada CF) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
42' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
41' This is a yellow card! Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
41' Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Abdon Prats (Mallorca) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:1.
35' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
35' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Predrag Rajkovic.
33' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
31' A cooling break is underway.
29' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
29' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
25' The possession of the ball – 54:46.
23' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
21' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
18' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
18' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
16' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Mallorca.
16' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) picked up a yellow card from referee.
15' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
12' 1 - 0 It's in! Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the top right corner after a cheeky lofted pass from Jose Callejon. 1:0.
11' Neat passing move from Granada CF in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' What terrific goalkeeping by Predrag Rajkovic! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) shoots only to the middle of the target, but with great power, forcing the keeper to pull off a difficult save.
7' The linesman signals that Jose Callejon (Granada CF) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' Referee Francisco Maeso sees the trip by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
4' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Granada CF force a corner. They send men into the box.

4' Granada CF move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The linesman points to the corner flag, Granada CF are going to take it.
1' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Granada CF will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francisco Maeso.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
